In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

IoT is the set of technologies and methodologies that allow the interconnection of any device, system, or object with any other, with the aim of providing new services to users and new opportunities to the economy.
IoT is not a single technology, but a complex set of technologies, which, when combined, can be used to create a pervasive and intelligent environment, which is the Internet of Things.
IoT is not a technology but a paradigm, and that it is not a solution but a set of solutions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

IoT is a new paradigm of computing, which has the potential to revolutionize the way we interact with the physical world, and that it is not just about the “things” that can be connected, but also about the way in which these “things” can be used to create value for society.

IoT is not only a technology, but also a paradigm, which is characterized by a strong pervasive nature and by a set of technologies that, in their turn, have to be regarded as the means to achieve its objectives.
IoT is a fast-evolving paradigm, with the ability to pervasively and pervadedly influence the life of individuals, communities, organizations, and nations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in order to be successful, IoT must be regarded as a paradigm, not as a single solution.
IoT has a strong and pervasive role to play in the future, and, if properly understood, can be a key element in the success of any new technology solution.
IoT is a complex and multifaceted concept, which is not limited to the simple integration of sensors, actuators, communication devices, and software, as often it is thought to be.
